title: Figures 19-20: Tic Tac CFD contours, temperature and Mach number at 1500 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. "Figure 19. Tic Tac Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1500 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" shows heating (in K) around the nose and in the wake, and "Figure 20. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1500 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" shows a low-speed wake within a high-Mach field. Page 43 of the BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report.
